thread:
maya: Starting RC creation: rc-20260318-1. Artifacts built from candidate branch feature/rls-opt. Requesting telemetry gate on staging before promo window at 17:30 UTC. KV warm planned. Please ack.
eng-release-bot: Artifact created: rc-20260318-1 SHA: abcdef1. Download: https://artifacts.redwood/rc-20260318-1.tar.gz. Release notes draft: - KV warm tweaks - model pin gptx-3b-v2-quant - batching defaults updated
dilip: Ack. I'll run smoke + traces on staging and validate 1) p50/p95/p99, 2) token cost delta, 3) error rate. Est 12m.
sheriff-bot: Oncall: sarah assigned for release sheriff tonight. sarah: please confirm.
sarah: I can take sheriff. I'll keep eyes on p99 latency, tail errors, and memory on GPU nodes. Golden thresholds: p99 < 450ms, errors < 0.5%. If those fail -> rollback.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to staging: /deploy rc-20260318-1 --env=staging --canary=5% at 3187654330
maya: Starting canary now. Running KV warm script and trace capture.
maya: KV warm logs: ```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api/redwood/kv/warm -d '{"prefix":"/rc/2026/03/18"}'
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/rc-20260318-1 -f --since=2m
```
dilip: Smoke results after 6m: p50 35ms, p95 210ms, p99 410ms, errors 0.12%. Token cost +3% (expected). Traces attached in perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/trace/abc123
sarah: p99 creeping to 430ms during a short spike but stabilized. Marking as pass for telemetry gate. I'll keep watch for next 12m.
maya: Noted. We are pinning model to gptx-3b-v2-quant for this RC to reduce performance variance.
dilip: Confirmed pin in the runtime config: ```yaml
model: gptx-3b-v2-quant
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
  dynamic: true
```
maya: Decision rule: if within 10m of full rollout p50 > 300ms for two consecutive 2min windows OR errors > 0.5% -> immediate rollback to rc-20260317-5 and open incident.
dilip: Also add automatic fallback policy to route traffic to regional-dedicated pool if latency spikiness detected: routing.policy: fallback=dedicated-eu
sarah: I'll trigger manual rollback if I see error rate jump or memory pressure above 85% on any GPU instance. Otherwise green light after 20m stable.
eng-release-bot: Promo window reserved: 17:30-18:30 UTC. Locking change window. Quiet window enforced: no infra-reconfig outside of rollbacks.
maya: Requesting final signoff at 17:50 UTC to promote to prod. Ops note: notify support channel 10m prior.
dilip: Support ping scheduled: /ping #support at 17:40 UTC
deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: /promote rc-20260318-1 --to=prod --start=17:52UTC --steps=\"10%:5m,50%:10m,100%:15m\". Will post live updates here.
sarah: Watching. If anything deviates from thresholds I'll call rollback and post reason + quick nettrace.
maya: Final checklist done: artifacts verified, model pin set, perf gates pass, docs updated. Release notes link: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-18-rc1
sarah: Signoff for promotion in 17m pending no regressions. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Promo started at 17:52UTC -> 10% traffic. live: https://status.redwood/releases/rc-20260318-1
dilip: Observability: p50 40ms p95 220ms p99 420ms errors 0.18%. No action.
sarah: 17:59UTC 50% traffic. p99 stable 425ms. no regressions. Holding.
maya: 18:11UTC 100% traffic. All services nominal. Closing the promo thread; document final release notes and tag the RC as prod.
eng-release-bot: RC rc-20260318-1 promoted to prod at 18:11UTC by deploy-bot. Changelog: https://changelogs.redwood/rc-20260318-1
sarah: Great run. I'll open a short retrospective doc for the KB: perf delta and cost impact.
maya: Thanks team. :tada:
